snippet.title: Loaded Lions: Mane City Game Tutorial
snippet.description:
Not intended for UK audience. Loaded Lions: Mane City is a tycoon simulation game where players design and build their dream cities and mansions with gold and diamonds generated from the in-game land that they own, alongside businesses they build on them such as gyms, banks and music stores. 

To play Loaded Lions’ Mane City game at launch,  you'll need to own a Land NFT from Crypto.com’s “Land - The First Frontier” NFT collection. 

Find out how you can get started with Mane City, or all things Mane City related at our website: 
Mane City Website 👉 https://mane.city/ 
Mane City Playbook 👉 https://learn.mane.city/ Jurisdictional Notice: This content is provided for general informational purposes only and is not intended for distribution to, or use by, persons in any jurisdiction where such distribution or use would be contrary to local laws or regulations.
